sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Subhash Chand, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant seeking direction to the
trial court to decide the Case No.694 of 2021 (State vs. Rohit Kumar @ Rohitash and others) arising
out of Case Crime No.146 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station- Chharra, District- Aligarh, within stipulated period.
3. Considering the fact that the aforesaid case is pending since 2021.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without Smt Monika vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131884855/
1 granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
Order Date :- 6.11.2024
